aboutProject.heroDesc: An integrated digital management system for running your online business
aboutProject.p1: Orderly is a comprehensive digital management system developed to help small and medium-sized businesses that rely on online sales manage their day-to-day operations efficiently and with ease. The project aims to provide a unified platform that brings all essential operational processes into a single system — including order management, inventory, customers, costs, revenue, profits, and analytical reporting — helping business owners monitor their commercial activities and make more accurate decisions based on real data.
aboutProject.p2: The project was born from observing the challenges faced by many online store owners and emerging brands. A large number of them still rely on paper records, traditional spreadsheets, or multiple separate apps to manage different aspects of their business. This increases the likelihood of errors, makes it difficult to track inventory and orders, and prevents them from gaining a clear view of their performance and profitability.
aboutProject.p3: Orderly provides an integrated work environment that helps users manage their business from one place. Through the system, you can add and organize products within inventory, record new orders and track their status through every stage of fulfillment, manage customer data and maintain a complete history of past transactions, and monitor expenses, revenue, and profits automatically and accurately.
aboutProject.p4: The system is built on a centralized database that ensures all data is stored in an organized and secure manner. It also provides interactive dashboards that display key performance indicators in real time — such as order count, sales volume, profit value, inventory status, and other information business owners need to continuously monitor their operations.
aboutProject.p5: One of Orderly's most important advantages is that it goes beyond simply recording data — it helps users analyze that data and turn it into actionable insights for decision-making. The platform delivers detailed reports on sales performance, best-selling products, revenue across different time periods, operating costs, and net profit, contributing to improved management efficiency and reduced financial risk.
aboutProject.p6: The app is designed to be easy to use and suitable for emerging business owners who may not have advanced technical expertise. The focus has been on providing simple, well-organized interfaces that help users access the information they need quickly and easily. The system also supports future expansion to add new features that meet the needs of different types of commercial activities.
aboutProject.p7: The project's vision is to become an integrated management platform serving all types of businesses that depend on e-commerce, and to support the digital transformation of small and medium enterprises by providing professional tools at an affordable cost with simplified operating procedures.
aboutProject.p8: Orderly aspires to help entrepreneurs and business owners manage their operations more efficiently, reduce losses caused by administrative errors, and improve their ability to plan and make decisions — ultimately increasing the chances of success, sustainability, and long-term growth for their businesses.

privacy.s1Text: We are currently in the early stages of application development, therefore we continuously update systems, develop databases, and improve the software environment. Through these processes, we aim to build a completely secure environment that protects user privacy, their data, and business details. By using the application, you acknowledge that the system is under development and agree to our current data processing practices.
privacy.s2Text:
We believe in the principle of minimal data collection, so we do not collect or access any private data except what is necessary to operate the service:

Basic data: We collect (username, number of orders, total revenue, total costs, product list and images).

Employee privacy: We do not access employee names or their private data within the manager's account, unless requested by the manager for technical support purposes.

Password encryption: Passwords are encrypted using one-way encryption technologies. No one, including application management, can see or decrypt the user's password, even if requested. In case of forgetting, only a new password can be assigned, ensuring highest levels of protection and fraud prevention.
privacy.s3Text:
Collected data is used for the following purposes:

Improving application features and enhancing user experience.

Sending necessary account-related notifications or updates.

Providing technical support based on user request.

Monitoring and preventing fraudulent activities, or preventing spam or inappropriate product images.
privacy.s4Text: We are fully committed not to sell, rent, or share any user or business data with any third parties for marketing or other purposes. Data is handled internally only for service provision, and is only disclosed in cases of legal compliance or at the explicit and written request of the account owner.
privacy.s5Text:
To maintain a professional work environment, users are prohibited from:

Visual Content: Posting inappropriate or offensive product images is strictly prohibited. Uploaded images (even in the costs section) should only represent the nature of the business activity.

Product Legality: Using the application to manage or sell any illegal products or products prohibited by law is prohibited.

Misuse: Any attempt to manipulate the application system or access other users' data will result in permanent account suspension.
privacy.s6Text:
The application user has the following rights:

Access to all application features available within their subscription.

The right to permanently delete their account from the database at any time.

The right to request export of their company data stored with us according to available technical procedures.

The right to report technical issues or human errors and communicate with customer service.

The right to submit suggestions for application improvement and cancel subscription at any time.
privacy.s7Text: Please note that the data export or transfer feature to external systems is currently unavailable. We are working on developing this feature, and all users will be notified once it is approved and technically available.
privacy.s8Text: As the application is under continuous development, we do our best to ensure service stability, but we are not responsible for any temporary data loss resulting from unforeseen technical circumstances. We always advise users to keep their own backups.
privacy.s9Text: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time to keep pace with technical and legal developments, and we will notify you of any material changes through the application.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Quick answers to common questions
faq.desc: Everything you need to know before getting started with Orderly
faq.a1: Download the app, subscribe, and add your data as shown in the app guide, then start using it smoothly.
faq.a2: Register in the app, go to your profile page, tap Subscribe Now, then choose the suitable monthly or yearly plan.
faq.q3: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faq.a3: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your profile page by tapping End Current Subscription.
faq.q4: Can an admin access the system by downloading an app other than Admin?
faq.a4: No. Each role must sign in only through its dedicated app.
faq.q5: What happens when a subscription ends?
faq.a5: All app features will be paused until the subscription is renewed.
faq.a6: Yes. There is a one-week free trial with the first subscription.
faq.a7: All local payment methods in Egypt are available, such as Fawry, e-wallets, credit cards, and more.
faq.a8: Yes. All payments are fully encrypted and secure, and we use top-tier payment gateways.
faq.q9: How do I contact support from inside the app?
faq.a9: Go to Support from Settings, tap Contact Us, and you can reach us anytime.
faq.q10: What are the technical support hours?
faq.a10: Support is available Saturday to Thursday from 9 AM to 8 PM.
faq.a11: Support is available by phone, email, WhatsApp, and from inside the app.
faq.a12: It calculates financial reports and data by tracking recorded sales and purchases, forecasting profits based on past results and current orders, and monitoring KPIs.
faq.a13: Yes. You can export financial reports and the income statement as an Excel sheet or PDF file.
faq.a14: Yes. You can create invoices for all orders in the Invoices page and print them as an image, PDF, or Excel sheet.
